content: The tool worked really well for me. I appreciate the person at Prusa who must have spent a long time designing this part just to make this easier!

Easiest way so far is just stick 2 mm hex tool into the upper hole. On the assembly tool, put finger on the hole with the upper nut. When you have assembly tool somewhere nearby the place shown, from outside pull the hexa tool out and in until you feel the tool hit the finger you have over the nut. Leave the hexa tool as is or even push it further in (just so it is secure enough). Now you have aligned the upper screw so just tighten the lower one. After that remove the hexa tool, put there screw and tighten it too.

replies.content: This worked for my i put the small hex key through the puck, and the hole and into the tool holding the nut, then screwed in the bottom screw followed by the top screw

content: For the nuts at the back, the arrow on the tool should point away from you towards the back of the machine. You can feel it catch the edge and then slide it up.
